title: Inventory & Supplies
subtitle: Stock on hand, movements, recipe costs, suppliers and purchase orders per store.

load.errorBody: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.

items.emptyBody: Add the ingredients and supplies this store keeps on hand to track stock and recipe costs.
items.noMatchBody: Try another name, SKU or category.

movements.title: Movement history
movements.subtitle: Every recorded stock change with its reason and the balance right after it.
movements.emptyBody: Receiving, sales consumption, adjustments and transfers will appear here as they happen.

moveDialog.title: Register stock movement
moveDialog.description: Record stock in, stock out, a loss, a count adjustment or a transfer to another authorized store.
moveDialog.noTargetStore: There is no other authorized store to transfer to.
moveDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. supplier delivery, trimming waste, moved to the other store
moveDialog.lossHint: Losses are saved as a manual adjustment; describe the loss in the reason.
moveDialog.noItems: Add a stock item before registering movements.
moveDialog.invalidQuantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
moveDialog.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for this movement.
moveDialog.failed: The movement could not be recorded

recipes.refreshCostsHint: Reload costs from current stock prices
recipes.refreshCostsSuccess: Costs reloaded from current stock prices
recipes.emptyBody: Link menu products to stock items to see cost per serving and estimated margin.

recipeDialog.description: Set ingredient quantities and yield to calculate cost per serving and estimated margin.
recipeDialog.noStoreItems: This store has no stock items yet. Add items before building the recipe card.
recipeDialog.prepPlaceholder: e.g. grill 3 minutes per side, melt cheese under a cover
recipeDialog.productRequired: Select the menu product for this recipe card.
recipeDialog.failed: The recipe card could not be saved

suppliers.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change suppliers.
suppliers.statusFailed: The supplier could not be updated
suppliers.emptyBody: Register the vendors you buy from to create purchase orders.

purchases.cancelConfirmBody: The order will be marked as cancelled and can no longer be received. Stock is not changed.
purchases.cancelFailed: The purchase order could not be cancelled

receiveHint.draft: Send it to the supplier to enable receiving.

purchases.emptyBody: Create a purchase order to receive goods into stock with price checks.
purchases.emptyNeedsSupplier: Register a supplier first, then create purchase orders.
purchases.sendSuccess: Purchase order marked as sent — it can now be received
purchases.sendFailed: The purchase order could not be sent

receiveDialog.title: Receive goods · {{number}}
receiveDialog.description: Check delivered quantities and invoice prices. Received quantities are added to stock when you confirm.
receiveDialog.success: Receiving recorded and added to stock
receiveDialog.failed: The receiving could not be recorded

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action in this store.
errors.location_forbidden: You don't have access to that store.
errors.invalid_quantity: That quantity isn't valid: stock can't go below zero and the change can't be zero.
errors.incompatible_units: The destination store tracks this item in a different unit.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This action was already submitted with different details. Close the dialog and try again.
errors.purchase_locked: This purchase order can't be received in its current status.
errors.invalid_receipt: Enter at least one received quantity.
errors.invalid_receipt_quantity: Received quantity exceeds what is still pending.
errors.received_purchase_requires_return: Orders with received goods can't be cancelled.
errors.org_suspended: This restaurant is suspended; changes are blocked.
errors.subscription_inactive: The subscription is inactive; changes are blocked.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have permission for this action.
